Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim old As Worksheet, sh As Worksheet, held As Range, wb As Workbook, page As PageSetup
    Set wb = ThisWorkbook
    Set sh = wb.Worksheets.Add(After:=wb.Worksheets(wb.Worksheets.Count))
    sh.Name = "Sum"
    sh.Range("A1").Value = 1
    Set old = wb.Worksheets("Sum")
    Set held = old.Range("A1")
    Set page = old.PageSetup
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    wb.Worksheets("Sum").Delete
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Set sh = wb.Worksheets.Add(After:=wb.Worksheets(wb.Worksheets.Count))
    sh.Name = "Sum"
    sh.Range("A1").Value = 5
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        Tried = old.Rows.Count
    Case 1
        Tried = old.Name
    Case 2
        Tried = old.Index
    Case 3
        Tried = TypeName(old)
    Case 4
        Tried = CStr(old Is Nothing)
    Case 5
        Tried = old.Range("A1").Value
    Case 6
        Tried = old.Cells(1, 1).Value
    Case 7
        Tried = old.Parent.Name
    Case 8
        Tried = old.Visible
    Case 9
        Tried = CStr(old Is ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Sum"))
    Case 10
        old.Name = "Other"
        Tried = "done"
    Case 11
        old.Activate
        Tried = "done"
    Case 12
        old.Delete
        Tried = "done"
    Case 13
        Tried = old.CodeName
    Case 14
        Tried = old.UsedRange.Address
    Case 15
        Tried = held.Value
    Case 16
        Tried = held.Address
    Case 17
        Tried = TypeName(held)
    Case 18
        Tried = held.Worksheet.Name
    Case 19
        Tried = page.PrintArea
    Case 20
        page.PrintArea = "$A$1:$C$9"
        Tried = "done"
    End Select
Done:
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    sh.Delete
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    Resume Done
End Function

Private Function Renamed() As String
    Dim a As Worksheet, b As Worksheet, wb As Workbook, s As String
    Set wb = ThisWorkbook
    Set a = wb.Worksheets.Add(After:=wb.Worksheets(wb.Worksheets.Count))
    a.Name = "X"
    a.Names.Add Name:="mark", RefersTo:="=""owner""", Visible:=False
    a.Name = "Y"
    Set b = wb.Worksheets.Add(After:=wb.Worksheets(wb.Worksheets.Count))
    b.Name = "X"
    s = "X:" & b.Names.Count & " Y:" & a.Names.Count & " " & a.Names(1).Name
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    a.Delete
    b.Delete
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Renamed = s
End Function

Public Function Probe() As String
    Dim s As String, i As Long
    For i = 0 To 20
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i)
    Next
    Probe = Mid(s, 4) & "@@@" & Renamed()
End Function
